description: Header record for an async LLM inference job. Immutable once created; status transitions live in com.etzhayyim.murakumo.inferenceJobEvent. Per ADR-2605191358 §event-sourced inferenceJob.

jobId.description: UUID; also used as rkey for direct lookup.

owner.description: DID or auth-kind tag of the requester.

promptPreview.description: First 200 chars of the user message. UI-only; not auth-sensitive.

requestBody.description: Verbatim JSON request body. May contain large messages; consider blob-ifying for very large prompts in a future revision.
